- The right-click menu items (selected links, all links on a page, one link, or the whole page) queue downloads again. Since they shipped, a menu click queued nothing at all — copies through the chip and the popup still worked, so most users just never saw the menu answer.
- New for hoster plugins whose direct link lives behind the site's own page: a plugin can now ask ripdl to open the share link in a hidden tab of your browser, let the page run through its own steps with your browser session, and catch the direct file address. No captcha-solver service is ever used; if a check genuinely needs you, the tab appears once for 40 seconds so you can pass it yourself.
- Selecting text that contains links now works even when the page cannot be read (restricted or protected pages): the exact text you selected is used instead.
- After updating, reload the browser extension if the reload does not happen on its own.
